description: Check a storefront domain's TXT record now. verified true means the domain is proven yours and the storefront answers there once routing is in place; otherwise reason and detail say what is missing. Only where the workspace has storefronts switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domain_id.description: The domain id, from list_storefronts or add_storefront_domain.

name: verify_storefront_domain
